overview: Cost-consequence analysis of switching a hospital headache clinic from paper to app diaries in January 2027, comparing follow-up appointments from July to December 2026 with January to June 2027, with a three-year budget impact estimate for injectable preventives.
population: Adults with migraine with at least one follow-up appointment in either period (about 950 per period).
exposure: App diary pathway from January 2027 (nurse set-up, paper kept on request) against the paper diary pathway.
procedures: The clinic nurse logs set-up time per patient; appointment lengths come from the booking system's start and end times; repeat appointments for deferred eligibility decisions from clinic letters; preventive prescriptions from pharmacy data; diary usability from the app export (DHS-2026-44) and a check of paper diaries against the consensus definition.

outcomes.name: Clinic cost per appointment episode
outcomes.measure: Nurse set-up time, appointment time and repeat appointments for deferred eligibility decisions, costed at 2026 staff rates
outcomes.timing: Per episode, six months either side of the switch

outcomes.name: Usable diary at the appointment
outcomes.measure: At least 28 consecutive prospective days with headache and medication days

outcomes.name: Time to eligibility decision
outcomes.measure: Weeks from first consideration to a decision on injectable preventives

outcomes.name: Usable diaries among patients aged 70 or over
outcomes.measure: Proportion with a usable diary, by diary type
outcomes.why: Checks that the switch does not disadvantage older patients.

feasibility: About 1,900 appointment episodes over a year; four nurse hours a week cover set-up logging and diary checks.
biasMitigation: Periods of equal length, same months of the clinical year avoided by using consecutive halves
Consensus definition of a usable diary applied to both periods
Budget impact reported separately from clinic costs

biasFlags.label: Before-after comparison
biasFlags.note: Other changes in 2027 may affect appointment use; logged and discussed.

biasFlags.label: Early learning effects
biasFlags.note: Set-up time may fall after the first months; reported by month.

parsimony.simplestPath: Two consecutive periods, one cost outcome, consequences tabulated beside it.

theoreticalFramework: None beyond CHEERS 2022 and budget impact good practice.
summary: Before-after cost-consequence analysis with a separate budget impact estimate.
